notes: Ring 0 pilot: 4 design records exercising the two-tier design workflow. Two reference records written retroactively from approved shapes, two rework records carrying full mind maps. Tier projection is defined in lib/si-registry/design-record-shape.js.

face.depicts: One large orb carrying the universal typing ellipsis: a single circle with three equal dots on the horizontal midline.

soul.purpose: Show the agent is reasoning and a response is forming.

metaphor_candidates.reason: Bubble adds a second container around the orb; double enclosure muddies at small sizes.
Spinners are the pattern this pack explicitly replaces; hourglass means waiting, not reasoning.

metaphor_candidates.idea: the orb itself carries the typing ellipsis
metaphor_candidates.reason: Merges the strongest chat convention (typing dots) with the agent identity (orb). One circle, three dots, nothing else.

anti_associations: more/overflow menu (dots without container read as menu)

distinct_from.differentiator: idle has no dots, only the breathing body
queue dots sit on a line outside any orb

construction.recipe: Orb r8.5 centered at 12,12. Dots r1.15 on the horizontal midline at x 8.2 / 12 / 15.8 (equal 3.8 spacing). Stroke render: 2px circle, filled dots. Solid render: filled circle, dots knocked out at r1.4. Elegance render: gOrb body, gGlass cap upper-left, middle dot accent.

external_comments.author: owner
external_comments.body: Approved in shape study round one; suitable shape, keep as reference standard.

face.depicts: Five vertical bars in a symmetric equalizer rhythm: heights 5, 10, 15, 10, 5 on a fixed 3.7 beat, round caps.

soul.purpose: Show live voice or audio activity level.

metaphor_candidates.reason: Body-part symbols read wrong for machine audio and age poorly.
Mic is reserved for capture-device icons (mic-on, mic-off) later in the pack.
The most universal audio-activity symbol; without a device it stays neutral about who is speaking.

anti_associations: bar chart (avoid baseline-aligned bars; center-align them)

distinct_from.differentiator: speaking has the orb; voice-wave is the sound alone
idle uses low flat bars at rest amplitude

motion.behavior: bars scale vertically in a staggered dance, center bar leads

construction.recipe: Five bars centered at 12,12: x positions 4.6 / 8.3 / 12 / 15.7 / 19.4 (3.7 rhythm), heights 5 / 10 / 15 / 10 / 5, center-aligned vertically. Stroke render: 2px lines, round caps. Solid render: 2.4-wide rounded rects. Elegance render: gInk gradient bars, center bar accent with glow behind.

external_comments.author: owner
external_comments.body: Approved in shape study round one and survived from mockup revision two; the pack keeper.

face.depicts: The orb wearing headphones (headband arc plus a rounded pad hugging each side), with one small sound wave per side split into a top and bottom segment, entering from outside each pad. The layered elegance render carries one unsplit wave per side, animated, since motion supplies the inbound effect.

soul.purpose: Show the agent is actively receiving audio input.

must_communicate.intensity: quiet (two waves per rule: 1-2 quiet, 3+ loud)

metaphor_candidates.reason: Human body part on an agent icon; also collides with accessibility/hearing icons.
Mic is the capture device, reserved for mic-on/mic-off icons; listening is a state of the agent.

metaphor_candidates.idea: sound waves converging on the orb (round-2 variant a)
metaphor_candidates.reason: Owner review 2026-07-06 round 2: still not suitable; four squiggles crowd the orb and the composition stays busy.

metaphor_candidates.idea: waveform absorbed into the orb (round-2 variant b)
metaphor_candidates.reason: Owner review 2026-07-06 round 2: still not suitable; asymmetric read did not land.

metaphor_candidates.idea: the orb wearing headphones, with one small incoming wave per side
metaphor_candidates.reason: Owner pick round 3. Headphones are the universal listening posture worn by the agent; the two small waves entering just outside the pads add the inbound direction. Works in both stroke and solid renders.

metaphor_candidates.idea: signal trail absorbed into the orb (variant d)
metaphor_candidates.reason: Owner review round 3: does not fit; removed from the list.

distinct_from.differentiator: speaking emits arcs outward from the orb; listening waves arrive at it
blast has no orb and fans one direction with 3 waves
idle has no orb and no direction

motion.behavior: waves pulse inward toward the orb in sequence (outer first), orb glass brightens slightly on arrival

spec.rest: full cycle includes a quiet beat

construction.recipe: Orb r5 at 12,14.5. Pads: rounded rects 2.4 x 5.5 (rx 1.2) hugging the orb at x 4.6 and 17, y 11.5. Headband: single arc pad-top to pad-top, M5.8 11.5 a6.2 6.2 0 0 1 12.4 0. Incoming wave (stroke and solid): one r3.4 arc per side (chord y 12.1 to 16.5 at x 3.2 / 20.8, convex toward the orb) split into top and bottom segments with a 1.2 gap at pad-center y 14.3; left top M3.2 12.1 A3.4 3.4 0 0 0 3.96 13.7, left bottom M3.96 14.9 A3.4 3.4 0 0 0 3.2 16.5, right mirrored with sweep 1. Elegance render: one unsplit wave per side, animated inward. Wave stroke weight 1.8 vs 2 for the headphones so the posture stays dominant.

external_comments.author: owner
external_comments.body: Round-one shape read as a steering wheel or drone; arcs too thick to read as sound waves; center did not read as an orb.

external_comments.author: owner
external_comments.body: Suggestion: two sound wave lines at both left and right side with the orb at the center.

external_comments.author: owner
external_comments.body: Conventional listening symbol is an ear with 2-3 wave lines; fine for humans, imagine a more fitting symbol for agents.

external_comments.author: owner
external_comments.body: Round 2: variants a and b still not suitable.

external_comments.author: owner
external_comments.body: Round 3: C might be the best fit; add 2 small wave lines entering the sides representing going in. Both solid and stroke work. D does not fit, remove.

external_comments.author: owner
external_comments.body: Round 4 clarification: two wave lines at EACH side for stroke and solid. For the layered version one wave line is good since the animation shows the inbound effect.

external_comments.author: owner
external_comments.body: Round 5: two waves per side is too much, too thick. Use one line per side split into top and bottom segments, both sides.

external_comments.author: owner
external_comments.body: Split-wave render approved. Pilot closed: all 4 records shape_approved.

face.depicts: The orb at center, not too small, with two nested sound waves at each of the four diagonal corners. Eight waves total: a lot of noise coming from the agent, in every direction.

soul.purpose: Represent a loud, sudden audio burst: a reaction blast moment.

must_communicate.actor: agent (orb present, the agent is the source)
must_communicate.intensity: very loud (eight waves, 3+ means loud per the pack rule)

metaphor_candidates.reason: Ray language reads as sun or sparkle; also the comic register belongs to the zorb set, not this pack.
Reads as a volume control, and the device grammar is reserved for actual device icons.

metaphor_candidates.idea: point source fanning three nested arcs one direction
metaphor_candidates.reason: Round 3: owner redirected to an orb-centric composition; the fan reads as the sound alone, but the blast should come from the agent. The dashed-clipping flourish had already been cut as decoration that cost clarity.

metaphor_candidates.idea: orb at center with two nested waves at each diagonal corner (owner suggestion)
metaphor_candidates.reason: Eight waves in all four diagonal directions read as overwhelming noise from the agent. Corner placement keeps the sides free, so it cannot be confused with orb-speaking's side ripples, and curved arc pairs avoid any sun or sparkle read.

distinct_from.differentiator: listening wears headphones or absorbs a signal; blast radiates waves outward from every corner
speaking ripples from the sides at conversational intensity (1-2 waves); blast fires 2 waves from all four diagonal corners
echo is concentric full rings; blast is corner arc pairs with the orb as source
shout is a jagged waveform mass with no orb; blast is the agent emitting

motion.behavior: arcs light in sequence from the source outward, then a long rest; source dot beats once per cycle

construction.recipe: Orb r5 at 12,12. Per diagonal corner, two concentric arcs centered on the orb spanning 50 degrees around the 45-degree diagonal, radii 7.2 and 9.8 (gaps: 2.2 orb-to-inner, 2.6 inner-to-outer). Top-right pair: M18.77 9.54 A7.2 7.2 0 0 0 14.46 5.23 and M21.21 8.65 A9.8 9.8 0 0 0 15.35 2.79; other corners mirrored. 2px round caps in stroke render; solid render fills the orb and thickens arcs to 2.4.

external_comments.author: owner
external_comments.body: Round-one shape read as the sun, not a sound blast.

external_comments.author: owner
external_comments.body: Show at least 3 sound wave lines to symbolize many or high audio; must not overlap with orb-listening if illustrated correctly.

external_comments.author: owner
external_comments.body: Round 2: three waves sufficient; questioned why the third wave was split into two. Split removed.

external_comments.author: owner
external_comments.body: Round 3: draw an orb at the center (not too small) with at least 2 waves at the four corners of the orb; 4x2 waves represents a lot of noise from the orb.

external_comments.author: owner
external_comments.body: Round 3 verdict: the stroke version is suitable. Stroke is the approved reference render.
